question: 先月の売上トップ10の商品名と売上を、売上降順・同額なら商品名順で見せて
sql: SELECT p.name, sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS sales FROM demo.orders o JOIN demo.order_items i ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN demo.products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY sales DESC,p.name LIMIT 10

question: 直近12か月の月別売上を年月昇順で見せて。年月はYYYY-MMで
sql: SELECT to_char(o.ordered_at,'YYYY-MM') AS month,sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS sales FROM demo.orders o JOIN demo.order_items i ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.ordered_at>=DATE '2025-10-01' AND o.ordered_at<DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025年9月と2026年9月の売上を年月昇順で比較して。年月はYYYY-MMで
sql: SELECT to_char(o.ordered_at,'YYYY-MM') AS month,sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS sales FROM demo.orders o JOIN demo.order_items i ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND (o.ordered_at>=DATE '2025-09-01' AND o.ordered_at<DATE '2025-10-01' OR o.ordered_at>=DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at<DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
